extracted.name: Healthy Filling Banana Coconut Bread
extracted.description: I LOVE this bread it tastes amazing and I have to do a double take to remember the ingredients. I feel full after eating one slice and all the ingredients are high in fiber and whole ingredients! Enjoy #march2026
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp ground flax and 3 tbsp (let sit to create a flax egg) or 1 normal egg
2 cups blended oats or oat flour(3 cups of whole oats)
.5 cup plus 1 tbsp or an overflowing.5 cup applesauce
Toppings: chocolate chips, oats, banana, coconut etc
instruction_lines: Blend your oats and measure 2 cups into a bowl, save the rest
Blend or mash your bananas and prepare your flax egg.
Mix all of your dry ingredients and spices together
Add in banana and other liquids
Spray a pan with olive or canola oil or coat with butter
Pour the batter in and place in the oven for 30-40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
Remove from pan and let set for 10 minutes before cutting off a slice.
Top with berries, chocolate spread, Greek yogurt or eat plain and enjoy!
